51605393.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to eEF2K (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant measured by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Assay: The experimental setup utilized chemically modified label-free photo-cross-linker sensor chips provided by Betterways Inc. For array spotting, a BioDot AD-1520 Array Printer deposited 1.875 nL/dot of each compound, generating four nonadjacent repetitions on the same chip. Subsequently, flow cell chambers were assembled and the chips were systematically tested with an SPR instrument. To establish controls, DMSO and PBS (pH = 7.0) solvents were crosswise tested for blank and background assessments. Real-time surface plasmon resonance was performed with a bScreen LB 991 Label-free Microarray System. The chip surface underwent three priming cycles with HBS-EP running buffer and one with running buffer (1 × PBS with 5% DMSO). The mouse ELP2 protein, at concentrations ranging from 10 to 2560 nM, was introduced over 600 s at 0.5 μL/s in each associating stage, followed by 360 s of running buffer at 0.5 μL/s in each dissociating stage. After each associating–dissociating cycle, surface regeneration was executed with a 30 s pulse of 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.5) at 20 μL/min.
